remedy the situation: The school quickly hired more bus drivers to remedy the situation after many students arrived late.
許多學生遲到後，學校迅速聘請更多公車司機來補救情況。
remedy a defect: The car company promised to remedy a defect in the brakes by repairing every car for free.
汽車公司承諾免費維修每輛車，以修正煞車的缺陷。
remedy the problem: Adding more trash cans in the park helped remedy the problem of litter on the grass.
在公園增設垃圾桶，幫助解決了草地上垃圾亂丟的問題。
a home remedy: My grandmother always makes hot ginger tea, a home remedy, whenever someone in our family catches a cold.
每當家裡有人感冒時，奶奶總會煮熱薑茶這個民俗療法。
remind someone to: Please remind your brother to bring his umbrella because it is going to rain this afternoon.
請提醒你弟弟帶傘，因為今天下午會下雨。
remind someone of: Old songs like this always remind me of the summer I spent with my cousins at the beach.
像這樣的老歌總是讓我想起和表兄弟姊妹在海邊度過的那個夏天。
that reminds me: Oh, that reminds me, I still need to return my library books before Friday.
噢，這讓我想到，我還得在星期五前把圖書館的書還回去。
render assistance: Volunteers rushed to the flooded village to render assistance to families who had lost their homes.
志工們趕往淹水的村莊，向失去家園的家庭提供協助。
render a service: The volunteers render a service to the community by teaching elderly people how to use smartphones for free.
志工們免費教長者使用智慧型手機，為社區提供服務。
render someone speechless: The amazing view from the top of Jade Mountain can render anyone speechless for a few minutes.
玉山山頂的壯麗景色能讓任何人啞口無言好幾分鐘。
render a verdict: After listening to both sides for three days, the jury is finally ready to render a verdict.
聽取雙方說法三天後，陪審團終於準備好做出裁決。
render into English: The publisher hired a famous translator to render into English the poet's beautiful Chinese poems.
出版社聘請一位知名譯者，把這位詩人優美的中文詩譯成英文。
render harmless: This special treatment can render harmless most of the bacteria found in our drinking water.
這種特殊處理可以使飲用水中大部分的細菌變得無害。
renew a contract: Because her first contract was about to expire, the company decided to renew a contract with her on the same terms.
因為她的第一份合約即將到期，公司決定以相同條件與她續約。
renew a passport: Before our trip to Japan, I went to the government office to renew a passport that had expired.
在去日本旅行前，我到政府機關去換發已過期的護照。
renew one's efforts: After failing the exam twice, Tom decided to renew his efforts and study every night until midnight.
考試失敗兩次後，Tom 決定重新努力，每晚讀書到半夜。
renew a friendship: After twenty years apart, the two classmates met at a reunion and decided to renew a friendship they had lost.
分開二十年後，兩位同學在同學會上相遇，決定重修舊好。
renew interest: Scientists hope the discovery of an old map will renew interest in the long-forgotten temple on the hill.
科學家希望一張舊地圖的發現，能重燃人們對山上那座被遺忘已久的寺廟的興趣。
renewed hope: The doctor's good news gave the family renewed hope that their father would recover soon.
醫生的好消息給了這家人重燃的希望，相信父親很快就會康復。
repay a loan: It took my uncle ten years to repay a loan he borrowed from the bank to buy his house.
我叔叔花了十年才還清向銀行借來買房子的貸款。
repay one's kindness: I baked cookies for my neighbor to repay her kindness after she took care of my dog.
鄰居幫我照顧狗之後，我烤了餅乾給她，以報答她的好意。
repay a favor: You helped me move last month, so let me repay a favor by fixing your computer this weekend.
你上個月幫我搬家，所以這週末讓我幫你修電腦來還人情吧。
repay the trust: The new captain promised to repay the trust the coach had placed in him by working harder than anyone.
新隊長承諾會比任何人都努力，以不負教練對他的信任。
replace a worker: The factory plans to replace a worker who retired last month with a younger engineer.
工廠打算用一位較年輕的工程師取代上個月退休的員工。
replace the battery: My phone dies so quickly these days that I really need to replace the battery soon.
我的手機最近很快就沒電，我真的得趕快換電池了。
replace A with B: Many cafés in Taiwan now replace plastic straws with paper ones to protect the ocean.
台灣許多咖啡廳現在用紙吸管取代塑膠吸管，以保護海洋。
be replaced by machines: Some people worry that many jobs in factories will be replaced by machines in the near future.
有些人擔心工廠裡的許多工作在不久的將來會被機器取代。
represent the country: She trained every day for years and was finally chosen to represent the country at the Olympic Games.
她多年來每天訓練，終於被選中代表國家參加奧運。
represent a threat: Scientists say that rising sea levels represent a threat to many small islands in the Pacific.
科學家說，海平面上升對太平洋許多小島構成威脅。
represent 10% of sales: Online orders now represent 10% of sales at the bookstore, and that number keeps growing.
網路訂單現在占這家書店銷售額的一成，而且還在持續成長。
represent a client: The lawyer agreed to represent a client who could not afford to pay for legal help.
這位律師同意代理一位付不起法律協助費用的客戶。
represent an improvement: The new phones represent an improvement over the old model, which was heavier and much slower.
新手機比舊款更進步，舊款更重而且慢得多。
represent oneself as: It is against the law to represent oneself as a doctor without a license and treat patients.
沒有執照卻自稱是醫生並為病人看診是違法的。
